items.title: Gothic Cross Decorative Panel Template for CNC Router and Laser Cut
items.description: A masterfully crafted architectural vector file combining a striking Gothic-style central cross with bold acanthus leaf scrolls. Provided in high-quality DXF, SVG, and DWG file formats, this cutting template offers an optimal balance between structural privacy and beautiful light filtration. Perfect for manufacturing custom wrought iron window grilles, garden privacy fences, and decorative metal gates with CNC plasma or fiber laser machines.
